chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Qasim narrated to us. He said: Yusuf ibn Muhammad ibn Ziyad and Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Yasar narrated to us from their fathers, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Musa ibn Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them), from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said:

The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said to one of his companions one day: O Abdullah! Love for the sake of Allah and hate for the sake of Allah, befriend for the sake of Allah and oppose for the sake of Allah, for the guardianship of Allah cannot be attained except through that, and no man can find the taste of faith -- even if his prayers and fasting are abundant -- until he is like that. The brotherhoods of people in your time have become mostly based on worldly matters; on that basis they show affection, and on that basis they harbor hatred, and that will avail them nothing before Allah. So he said to him: How can I know that I have befriended and opposed for the sake of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic? Who is the friend of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, that I should befriend him, and who is His enemy that I should oppose him? The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) pointed to Ali (peace be upon him) and said: Do you see this one? He said: Yes. He said: The friend of this one is the friend of Allah, so befriend him. The enemy of this one is the enemy of Allah, so oppose him. Befriend the friend of this one even if he killed your father and your son, and oppose the enemy of this one even if he is your father and your son.

key_terms.طعم الايمان: Taste of faith -- the experiential sweetness of genuine belief
key_terms.ولاية الله: Guardianship/friendship of Allah (wilayat Allah) -- the spiritual bond with Allah attained through correct allegiance
key_terms.ووال في الله وعاد في الله: Befriend for Allah and oppose for Allah -- the principle of allegiance (tawalli) and dissociation (tabarri)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about loving and hating for Allah's sake and the role of Ali?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (s) taught one of his companions that true faith requires loving for Allah's sake, hating for Allah's sake, befriending for Allah's sake, and opposing for Allah's sake. Without this, one cannot attain Allah's guardianship nor taste true faith, regardless of how much one prays or fasts. He warned that most people's bonds are based on worldly matters, which avail nothing before Allah. When the companion asked how to know who to befriend and who to oppose, the Prophet pointed to Ali (as) and said: the friend of Ali is the friend of Allah, and the enemy of Ali is the enemy of Allah -- befriend Ali's friend even if he killed your father, and oppose Ali's enemy even if he is your father.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Qasim narrated to us. He said: Yusuf b. Muhammad b. Ziyad and `Ali b. Muhammad b. Yasar narrated to us from their fathers from al-Hasan b. `Ali b. Muhammad b. `Ali b. Musa b. Ja`far b. Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) from his father from his forefathers (as). He said:

The Messenger of Allah (s) said to one of his companions that day: O `Abdullah! Love in the way of Allah, hate in the way of Allah, befriend in the way of Allah, and oppose in the way of Allah, for the wilaya of Allah is only achieved through this. A man cannot taste faith, even if he increases his prayer and his fasting, until he does all this. In this day and age, the people are brotherly over this world – they love one another over it, and they hate one another over it; yet it will not make them free of the need for Allah. So, it was said to him: How will I know that I have befriended and opposed in the way of Allah? Who is the friend of Allah, so that I may befriend him; and who is His enemy, so that I may oppose him? So, the Messenger of Allah (s) pointed to `Ali (as) for him and said: Do you see this? So, he said: Of course. He said: His friend is the friend of Allah, so befriend him. His enemy is the enemy of Allah, so oppose him. Befriend his friend, even if he killed your father and your son; and oppose his enemy, even if he is your father or your son.
